race.comment: COMMANCHE BLING (1) settled handy and finished well to finish a very close second last start over 1780m at this track. Has the benefit of a good draw. Meets a comparable field and she can take this out. MADAM FIRST LADY (2) settled handy and kept trying only to find a couple better on debut last time out over 1780m at this track, beaten just 1.5 metres. Likely to get all the favours from this nice draw. That latest effort is good enough to win a race of this calibre. MISTA WICKED (8) is in the mix following a respectable third at his most recent appearance over 1780m at this track. SIMPLY INSPIRING (5) last appeared when fourth over 1660m at Albion Park five months ago. Must be respected.
